name: live_stealth
description: Detection of the party uses the best-seen player (world::coop::combat_live::party_detection, which GetDetected on the player also uses in a co-op session). Both players stand together in Doc Mitchell's house. At 7 s the host probes how well gecko 1 detects the party from 700 units (coop probeparty: the NPC stands 700 units from the host and looks at it). At 10 s the host sneaks, the guest does not. At 14 s the host probes again. The host's own value drops by at least 10, but the party's value does not drop: the guest, a remote player in plain sight, still gives the party away. At 1.5 s the host makes gecko 1 a ghost (SetGhost 1): in the real game the gecko and Doc Mitchell fight on sight, and a detector in combat sees much less, so the probe would not measure plain stealth.
